words.def: to exist or to have a particular quality
words.ex: I want to be a doctor one day.

words.def: to own or hold something
words.ex: They have two children.

words.def: to perform an action or a task
words.ex: What do you do on weekends?

words.def: to move or travel to another place
words.ex: We go to the gym every morning.

words.def: to receive or obtain something
words.ex: Did you get my message?

words.def: to create or produce something
words.ex: She made a cake for the party.

words.def: to have information or understanding in your mind
words.ex: I know the answer to that question.

words.def: to use your mind to consider something
words.ex: I think it will rain today.

words.def: to hold something and move it, or to accept it
words.ex: Take an umbrella; it looks like rain.

words.def: to notice something using your eyes
words.ex: Can you see the mountains from here?

words.def: to move towards the speaker or a place
words.ex: Come here and look at this.

words.def: to wish for or desire something
words.ex: I want a cup of tea.

words.def: to do something with a tool or object
words.ex: Can I use your phone for a minute?

words.def: to discover something after looking for it
words.ex: I can't find my keys.

words.def: to hand something to someone
words.ex: Give me the book, please.

words.def: to give information to someone by speaking
words.ex: Tell me what happened.

words.def: to do a job, usually to earn money
words.ex: She works at a hospital.

words.def: to telephone someone, or to give a name
words.ex: I will call you tonight.

words.def: to make an effort to do something
words.ex: Try to finish it before lunch.

words.def: to say a question, or to request something
words.ex: Ask her where the station is.

words.def: to speak words aloud
words.ex: She said hello and smiled.

words.def: to turn your eyes towards something
words.ex: Look at that beautiful bird.

words.def: to experience an emotion or physical sensation
words.ex: I feel tired after work.

words.def: to go away from a place or person
words.ex: We leave for the airport at noon.

words.def: to move something into a place or position
words.ex: Put the keys on the table.

words.def: to have and hold something; to continue
words.ex: Please keep this a secret.

words.def: to allow someone to do something
words.ex: Let me help you with that.

words.def: to start doing something
words.ex: The lesson begins at nine.

words.def: to make it easier for someone to do something
words.ex: Can you help me carry this?

words.def: to speak with someone
words.ex: We talked for hours last night.

words.def: to move so as to face another direction
words.ex: Turn left at the next corner.

words.def: to begin to happen or to do something
words.ex: The film starts in ten minutes.

words.def: to let someone see something
words.ex: Show me your new photos.

words.def: to notice a sound with your ears
words.ex: I can hear music next door.

words.def: to take part in a game or make music
words.ex: The kids play in the park.

words.def: to move quickly on your feet
words.ex: She runs five kilometres every day.

words.def: to change position or place
words.ex: Please move your car.

words.def: to have your home in a place; to be alive
words.ex: They live in Kyiv.

words.def: to think that something is true
words.ex: I believe you are right.

words.def: to carry something to a place or person
words.ex: Bring your umbrella just in case.

words.def: to make words on paper or a screen
words.ex: Please write your name here.

words.def: to rest with your body upright on a seat
words.ex: Come and sit next to me.

words.def: to be on your feet in an upright position
words.ex: We had to stand on the bus.

words.def: to come together with someone by chance or plan
words.ex: Let's meet at the café.

words.def: to give money for goods or services
words.ex: I paid for the tickets online.
